title: "4T1-Tmem165 petri dish RNA-seq"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DESeq2)
library(tximport)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(ensembldb)
library(RMariaDB)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(Orthology.eg.db)
library("vsn")
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(msigdbr)
library(apeglm)
library(pheatmap)
```
  The RNA-seq data contains 2 conditions: 4T1-Int2 (Ctrl-KO) and 4T1-Tmem165-KO. With 3 repliates each.
  First, RNA-seq reads were quantified using Salmon/1.8.0. 
  Transcriptome version: GRCm39, Esembl 108
1. We will import count files using tximport, and perform alignment QC using STAR + Qualimap.
```{r}
# Load metadata and tx2gene file
dir <- "~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/4T1_Tmem165_petri_bulk_RNAseq"
meta <- read.table(file.path(dir,"analysis/Tmem165_metadata_249.csv"), sep=",",header=T)
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition)
meta$Genotype <- factor(meta$Genotype)
txdb <- makeTxDbFromEnsembl(organism="Mus musculus", release=108)
k <- keys(txdb, keytype="TXNAME")
tx2gene <- select(txdb, k, "GENEID", "TXNAME")
# Load Salmon output using tximport
files_Tmem165 <- file.path(dir,paste("salmon/",meta$Sample,"_salmon", sep=""),"quant.sf")
names(files_Tmem165)<-meta$Sample
txi_data <- tximport(files_Tmem165, type="salmon",tx2gene=tx2gene, ignoreTxVersion = T)
write.table(txi_data$counts, file = file.path(dir, "Analysis/gene_counts_Tmem165.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```
2. Make DEseq dataset
```{r}
names(txi_data)
head(txi_data$counts)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi_data, colData = meta, design = ~Condition)
colnames(dds) <- meta$Sample
dds
```

```{r}
# Data QC, remove genes with low counts
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep,]
```

```{r}
# Run DESeq
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)
resultsNames(dds)
```

```{r}
#dds <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "analysis/4T1_Tmem165_deseq2.rds"))
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("Condition","4T1_Tmem165","4T1_Int2"))
saveRDS(dds, file.path(dir, "analysis/4T1_Tmem165_deseq2.rds"))
```

```{r}
# LFCshrink
resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="Condition_4T1_Tmem165_vs_4T1_Int2", type="apeglm")
resLFC
plotMA(res, ylim=c(-3,3))
plotMA(resLFC, ylim=c(-3,3))
```
```{r}
# Data visualization using PCA
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=F)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup=c("Condition"))
meanSdPlot(assay(vsd))
```

```{r}
summary(res)
res.df <- as.data.frame(res)
head(res.df)
```
```{r}
# RNA
genenames <- select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys= keys(org.Mm.eg.db, keytype="ENSEMBL"), columns=c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"), keytype="ENSEMBL")
resfile <- res
filename <- "Tmem165_vs_Int2.deseq2_output.tsv"
plotname <- "Tmem165_vs_Int2"

  resp_table <- merge(as.data.frame(resfile), genenames, by.x=0, by.y="ENSEMBL")
  resp_table <- resp_table[!duplicated(resp_table$SYMBOL),]
  resp_table <- resp_table %>% remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")
  resp_table <- resp_table[order(resp_table$padj), ]
  Volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(resp_table, lab=rownames(resp_table), x="log2FoldChange", y="padj", title= plotname, xlim = c(-8,8), ylim=c(0,120), pointSize = 1, pCutoff=10e-5, FCcutoff=1, labSize=4) # One or more p-values is 0. Converting to 10^-1 * current lowest non-zero p-value
  print(Volcano)

write.table(resp_table, file=file.path(dir,"DEseq2",filename), sep='\t', row.names=T)
  resSig <- subset(resp_table, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5)
  resSig <- resSig[order(-resSig$log2FoldChange),] # Descending
  print(str(sum(resSig$log2FoldChange > 0)), str(sum(resSig$log2FoldChange < 0)))
  write.table(resSig, file=paste(dir, "/DEseq2/",plotname,".deseq2_significant.tsv",sep=""), sep='\t', row.names=T)
```

3. Prepare dataset for GSEA
```{r}
norm_counts <- as.data.frame(counts(dds, normalized=T))
norm_counts <- cbind(DESCRIPTION = "na", norm_counts)
write.table(norm_counts, file=file.path(dir, "analysis/norm_counts.txt"), sep="\t")
```
